title: Dussīlasuttaṃ
text: 289 . ‘‘Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo…pe… nirayaṃ upapajjati. Katamehi pañcahi? Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, dussīlo ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti – imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo…pe… nirayaṃ upapajjatī’’ti. Dasamaṃ.
